title: Adaptive-precision root evidence and singular endpoint refinement
objective: Determine which charged high-precision refinement and root-evidence mechanisms can safely recover accurate targets from fixed near-rank or singular local endpoints without changing discovery, requiring polynomial lowering, or treating point replay as a root certificate.
hypothesis: A capability-routed precision ladder with stable rank diagnostics, explicit configuration and target error evidence, and a separately validated C3V path will repair many near-rank endpoints; singular-specific Broyden or bordered-nullspace lanes will help only identifiable strata and must otherwise remain unknown.

included: fixed Float64 endpoints emitted by the frozen local champion
C2 numeric-generic black-box relation and target evaluation
regular ill-conditioned, rank-transition and isolated singular roots
regular and singular feasible manifolds as non-promotion controls
optional C3V interval configuration verification when every executed path declares the capability
separate semantic replay, numerical root evidence and validated root evidence artifacts
excluded: global start generation, archive policy, scheduler policy or target deduplication changes
whole-system Groebner, RUR, polynomial homotopy or mandatory symbolic lowering
general singular-root certification without a declared numerical or validated evidence contract

literature.claim: Adaptive multiprecision can allocate digits from local conditioning and requested accuracy instead of paying high precision along an entire numerical path.
literature.assumptions: The function and Jacobian are evaluable at the requested precision and condition estimates are useful with safety margins.
literature.break_conditions: The result concerns homotopy path tracking and does not prove that an arbitrary least-squares endpoint is a root or isolated.

literature.claim: Residual evaluation, Jacobian and linear-solve error, and update rounding jointly limit Newton residual and forward accuracy even when residuals use extended precision.
literature.assumptions: The local Newton model and its regularity/error assumptions match the executed system.
literature.break_conditions: Poor conditioning separates residual size from forward accuracy and singular roots invalidate a regular inverse bound.

literature.claim: For rank-deficient nonlinear least squares with nonzero residual, truncated SVD substitution can be unstable and column subset selection is recommended for the studied setting.
literature.assumptions: The problem is locally described by the rank-deficient nonlinear least-squares model in the paper.
literature.break_conditions: A noisy numerical rank transition or zero-residual singular root does not inherit the nonzero-residual result.

literature.claim: Broyden iteration converges linearly for a stated class of roots with singular Jacobian when initialized in a special local region.
literature.assumptions: The singularity class and initial-region hypotheses hold.
literature.break_conditions: The result is local, class-specific and neither distinguishes a manifold nor gives all-root coverage.

literature.claim: Approximate left and right nullspaces can form bordered systems with quadratic local convergence near generalized regular singularities.
literature.assumptions: An isolated generalized-regular singular root and reliable rank/nullspace estimates are available.
literature.break_conditions: Manifolds, changing rank, unavailable derivatives or a wrong nullity estimate invalidate the route.

literature.claim: Rigorous numerical verification checks theorem assumptions with directed-rounding enclosures rather than relying on a higher-precision point value.
literature.assumptions: Sound interval extensions and the derivative enclosures required by the selected test are available.
literature.break_conditions: Opaque point-only callbacks or a singular interval Jacobian cannot silently satisfy a standard regular-root verification test.

literature.claim: Interval Krawczyk methods can certify isolated nonsingular roots when a sound interval model is available.
literature.assumptions: The system has an isolated nonsingular root and every operation supplies a sound interval extension over the candidate box.
literature.break_conditions: Singular roots, feasible manifolds and C0/C2-only black boxes do not satisfy this certificate path.

controls.description: Current unchanged-coordinate C2 canonical point replay after the solver-side inconclusive-image fail-closed repair.
Fixed identity-free ill-conditioned systems whose residual-qualified endpoints are far from their unique Gold root.
differences_from_baseline: Adversarial near-null endpoint supplied directly to the refinement stage

controls.description: Generated-family refinements using independently coded analytic Jacobian and higher directional derivative information.
differences_from_baseline: Gold-independent analytic derivatives available only to bound derivative-estimation loss

candidates.description: Adaptive-precision normalized LM-QR re-refinement with precision/radius rank stability, correction-based configuration error and propagated target error estimates.
The S1 ladder with pivoted-QR column subset selection when rank is stable but the nonzero-residual local model is rank deficient.
Multiprecision good-Broyden refinement, routed only after stable singular diagnostics and independently confirmed from fixed perturbations.
Multiprecision bordered left/right-nullspace correction for stable generalized-regular isolated singular candidates.
Capability-gated interval Krawczyk configuration verification for isolated measured-regular candidates after numeric refinement.

synthetic_families.purpose: Measure residual-versus-forward-error failure and adaptive digit demand without an exactly singular Jacobian.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Constructed orthogonal factors, analytic unique root and independently evaluated target

synthetic_families.purpose: Compare generic and singular-specific refiners on isolated roots with stable Jacobian nullspaces.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic multiple roots and independently coded derivative tensors

synthetic_families.purpose: Prevent isolated-singular heuristics from promoting feasible manifolds or locally flat target variation as finite answers.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Parameterized analytic manifolds and exact target restrictions

synthetic_families.purpose: Separate an ill-conditioned regular pair from a coalesced singular root and preserve distinct target recall.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Closed-form circle-line and polynomial-fold roots with independent target descriptors

synthetic_families.purpose: Reject least-squares stationary points and inconsistent redundant systems despite package success or stable iterates.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic proof of no zero in the endpoint neighborhood plus exhaustive low-dimensional interval control

synthetic_families.purpose: Verify explicit C0/C2/C3V routing across opaque compositions, guards, domains and stable branches.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Audited plugin semantics and independently materialized valid/invalid configurations

real_problem_policy: Only independently audited Gold endpoints may affect selection. Production routing cannot see family, problem, primitive, file or target identity; translated problems are timing-only until separately audited.

execution_order: Materialize and checksum endpoints, Gold roots, transformations and capability reports before candidate implementation
Run the fixed P1 false-root and manifold controls against every evidence constructor before any performance pilot
Run a non-gating adapter pilot and discard implementations that violate budgets, precision isolation or canonical semantics
Compare S0, S1 and S2 on paired regular and near-rank development endpoints
Compare S1, S3 and S4 only on stable-rank-deficient isolated-singular development endpoints
Run S5 on the C3V-eligible regular subset and require an explicit unavailable result elsewhere
Use at most one development tuning round, then freeze precision, rank, confirmation and route rules
Run one generator-disjoint locked validation and select promote, specialize or reject per route
design.pairing: Every variant receives the identical frozen endpoint, normalized scales, deadline, capability lock, Gold-hidden oracle, perturbation stream and canonical semantic replay; all failed probes and fallbacks are charged.
design.freeze_rule: Precision ladder, derivative stencil, rank stability rule, error reserve, route order and evidence constructors freeze together before locked validation.
design.locked_validation_rule: Inspecting a locked endpoint burns its complete generator/transform seed block and requires a generator-disjoint replacement before another locked run.
notes: Fixed endpoints isolate F9/F12/F13 from global discovery and archive effects.
SemanticReplayEvidence cannot construct a public answer without NumericalRootEvidence or ValidatedRootEvidence.
C2 error envelopes are empirical provisional evidence and must never be described as rigorous interval certificates.
A singular lane may be specialized to a diagnosed stratum; failure to find a universal winner is an expected valid result.

precision_ladder_bits.rationale: Covers the fixed 1e-16 near-null factor while bounding arbitrary-precision cost.
precision_ladder_bits.freeze_rule: One development comparison; never extend after a locked failure.

required_precision_guard_bits.rationale: Adds a safety reserve beyond requested target bits and estimated condition loss.
required_precision_guard_bits.freeze_rule: Choose once from development undercoverage and cost, then freeze.

maximum_refinement_iterations.rationale: Allows slowly convergent singular traces without unbounded endpoint work.
maximum_refinement_iterations.freeze_rule: Identical hard limit for every C2 candidate.

per_endpoint_oracle_limit.rationale: Bounds finite-difference, confirmation and fallback work at all precisions.

central_difference_epsilon_exponent.rationale: Balances central-difference roundoff and truncation for smooth black-box functions.
central_difference_epsilon_exponent.freeze_rule: Compare only against analytic derivative controls on development.

rank_roundoff_multiplier.rationale: Separates numerical noise from stable rank while requiring agreement across precisions and radii.
rank_roundoff_multiplier.freeze_rule: A single multiplier applies without family or identity exceptions.

rank_stability_radius_count.rationale: One stencil cannot distinguish truncation error from a true near-null direction.
rank_stability_radius_count.freeze_rule: Same count for every route and capability.

independent_confirmation_count.rationale: Independent perturbation/refinement traces expose stable nonroot stationary points and route sensitivity.
independent_confirmation_count.freeze_rule: Confirmation endpoints and counter seeds are materialized before execution.

confirmation_perturbation_radius.rationale: Tests a local capture neighborhood without rerunning global discovery.
confirmation_perturbation_radius.freeze_rule: Choose on development regular/singular capture curves, not per instance.

error_reserve_multiplier.rationale: Combines last correction, precision disagreement and target propagation into a conservative provisional envelope.
error_reserve_multiplier.freeze_rule: Any development undercoverage eliminates the tested value rather than widening after locked results.

target_error_goal.rationale: Matches the current validated target consistency scale while measuring stricter Gold error separately.
target_error_goal.freeze_rule: Safety threshold; never relaxed from observed failures.

c3v_initial_box_multiplier.rationale: Seeds interval verification from the numerical configuration-error estimate with bounded inflation.
c3v_initial_box_multiplier.freeze_rule: Choose once on development certificate success and width.

singular_route_trigger.rationale: Avoids routing from one Float64 SVD cutoff or problem identity.

budgets.accounting: Charge every C0/C2/C3V callback, failed stencil, confirmation perturbation, Jacobian or directional derivative, factorization, rank diagnostic, semantic replay, certificate replay, compilation and cold/warm wall time. Report raw callbacks and precision-equivalent oracle work using callback_cost * ceil(bits/53); hard deadline and oracle limits apply inside every route and fallback.

seeds.generation: Problem, affine transform, endpoint perturbation, confirmation and execution-order seeds use separate namespaces; full materialized inputs and checksums are frozen before candidate runs.

primary.definition: Fraction of fixed endpoints producing required root evidence, a canonical-valid configuration and a target enclosure containing the independent Gold target.

secondary.definition: Fraction of Gold endpoints eligible for a public provisional or validated answer after every evidence gate.
Fraction of promoted C2 endpoints whose declared configuration-error estimate contains the Gold configuration distance.
Fraction of promoted endpoints whose target enclosure contains the independent Gold target.
Charged callbacks weighted by ceil(precision_bits divided by 53) through root evidence or typed unknown.
Cold and warm wall time from fixed endpoint to accepted root evidence, reported separately.
Typed unknown outcomes partitioned by capability, unstable rank, singular class, guard, branch, budget and certificate failure.
Fraction of equivalent coordinate, residual and graph transforms selecting equivalent routes and answer decisions.

safety.definition: Public provisional answers whose configuration or target fails independent Gold truth.
Answers constructed from point semantic replay without numerical or validated root evidence.
Verified payloads or public answers emitted from TARGET_IMAGE_INCONCLUSIVE diagnostics.
C2 or C3V unavailability that silently downcasts or changes the assurance claim.
Endpoints exceeding declared callback, iteration, precision or wall deadlines including fallback work.

criteria: False-provisional, semantic-replay-only, inconclusive-image, silent-capability-fallback and budget-overrun counts are zero on fixed controls, development and locked validation.
Every public provisional answer carries both SemanticReplayEvidence and NumericalRootEvidence, or SemanticReplayEvidence and independently replayable ValidatedRootEvidence.
P_refinement_gold improves by at least 15 percentage points overall or precision-equivalent work drops by at least 20 percent at equal P_refinement_gold.

Near-rank and isolated-singular strata each improve by at least 10 percentage points for any promoted general or specialized route, with a family-clustered one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero.
No regular well-conditioned, manifold, close-root, strict-guard or stable-branch critical stratum loses more than 2 P_promotable_gold points.
Every promoted locked C2 endpoint has Gold-contained configuration and target error estimates; every promoted C3V endpoint replays an existence/uniqueness certificate independently.
Equivalent variable rotations, residual-row transformations, scale-preserving reformulations, redundant relations and graph reorderings produce zero answer-decision disagreements.
Warm regular-endpoint overhead is at most 10 percent and cold setup breaks even within 32 eligible endpoints unless a critical-stratum recall gain of at least 10 points remains.
The gain repeats in at least three unrelated families after the single declared tuning round.
The fixed near-null false-root, nonroot stationary or feasible-manifold control produces a verified payload or public answer.
Point BigFloat agreement, a package return code, a residual threshold or one numerical rank cutoff is used as an answer predicate.
Any promoted C2 configuration or target error estimate excludes its locked Gold value.
A coordinate rotation, equivalent residual transformation or graph rewrite changes a promotion decision.
C2 or C3V capability failure silently falls back while retaining the stronger assurance label.
All singular-specific candidates improve P_refinement_gold by less than 5 points after precision, derivative, fallback and confirmation work are charged.
Regular-family warm overhead exceeds 10 percent without a critical recall gain, or cold cost does not break even within 128 endpoints.
The selected gain fails to reproduce after the one permitted development tuning round.

safety_invariants: Canonical relation, truth, domain, guard, branch and target semantics remain the only final semantic replay.
SemanticReplayEvidence alone can never construct a public answer.
TARGET_IMAGE_INCONCLUSIVE remains diagnostic and refinement-only regardless of residual or precision agreement.
Exact-zero residual does not imply that a root is isolated or that a finite target image exists.
Routing uses only capabilities, dimension, scale, charged progress, residual, stable rank/condition and margin diagnostics.
No route reads problem, family, primitive, file, configuration or target identity.
C3V verification requires sound interval support on every executed path and never silently degrades to C2.
Surrogate, subset, secant and bordered systems only propose refinements; unchanged canonical semantics decide validity.
Every callback, precision increase, failed probe, confirmation and fallback is charged before deadline checks return control.
The open Literal, Reference, Call and Select graph plus PluginSpec ABI is unchanged by the experiment.
